desc.testo: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd. (CPIC) known as Pacific Insurance, is a Chinese insurance company. It was established on the basis of the former China Pacific Insurance Corporation, which was founded in 1991 approved by the People's Bank of China. Its headquarters is in Shanghai.
desc.trad: China Pacific Insurance (Group) Co., Ltd. (CPIC), conosciuta come Pacific Insurance, è una compagnia assicurativa cinese. È stata fondata sulla base dell'ex China Pacific Insurance Corporation, fondata nel 1991 e approvata dalla Banca popolare cinese. La sua sede è a Shanghai.
